depends_on: Ramare 1995 Lemma 3.4 (sum mu^2(q)/phi(q) = log R + gamma + sum_p log p/(p(p-1)) + O(R^(-1/3)))
notes: kappa = lim(F_n - H_n) = c_E - gamma = sum_p log p/(p(p-1)) = B_3 - gamma by Ramare's asymptotic and H_n = log n + gamma + o(1). check.py: F(1e6)-H(1e6) = 0.755358 vs 0.7553666. Outside Lean: the whole identity (Ramare 1995 Lemma 3.4). Grouped: write-up in OEIS/A138312.
